description: This file defines the RpmModel class, which manages RPM data with smoothing functionality, listening to sensor updates and notifying registered listeners about RPM changes.

classes.name: RpmModel
classes.description: Singleton class providing RPM value management with smoothing and listener notification.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RpmModel.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the RPM value and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getSmoothedValue
methods.description: Returns the smoothed RPM value based on recent updates and a smoothing ratio.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be notified on RPM changes.
